The main takeaway from our work is that
the time resolution of the fiber counters can be as good as 1.2 ns at the shower maximum and as good as 2 ns at a depth of 10 radiation lengths.
the time resolution in hadronic showers is limited by the time spread of the electromagnetic component of the showers.
the fiber counter is a better choice than the hodoscope for time of flight measurements with a time resolution better than 100 ps.
